column1: # note: The Rhode Island Tax Computation Worksheet on page T-1, for taxable income of $100,000 or more, for all filing status types: (a) line 7 times (b) the multiplication amount, less (d) the subtraction amount. Each row holds base_tax = -(d) and of_excess_over = 0.
# note: The same page prints the Tax Rate Schedule, which gives the same tax; the worksheet is the one it says to use.
# note: It is repeated for every filing status. The worksheet and Form RI-1040 say nothing of rounding, so the worksheet tax is taken to the cent.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
